arguments.query: SELECT o.order_ts, o.status, i.quantity, i.unit_price_cents, p.list_price_twd FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id LIMIT 8
SELECT order_ts FROM orders ORDER BY order_ts LIMIT 3
SELECT refund_ts, refund_amount_twd, item_id FROM refunds LIMIT 5

WITH o AS (SELECT o.order_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE c.region_code='TW-N' AND c.tier='G' AND o.status IN (1,2,3) AND strftime('%Y',datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours'))='2025') SELECT (SELECT SUM(quantity*unit_price_cents) FROM order_items WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM o))/100.0 AS gross, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(refund_amount_twd),0) FROM refunds WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM o)) AS refunds, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM o) n
SELECT region_code, tier, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY 1,2
